c74object.name: anira~
c74object.digest: Neural network inference wrapper for Max
c74object.description: Neural network inference wrapper for Max. The anira~ external integrates the anira library to offer neural network inference inside Max. Inlets and outlets are dynamically configured during object initialization streamable (signal) and non-streamable (message) data. The last outlet always outputs the processing latency.

metadatalist.metadata: Valentin Ackva, Fares Schulz, Konstantin Fontaine
